loss_scale_policy: shared train-only RMS baseline residual over all native steps through 1s
loss_aggregation: mean of scaled squared vector norms / squared geodesic angles over valid native future steps per window, then equal windows
phase_forecast: hold last valid frequency if valid at origin; advance last phase by 2*pi*f*elapsed; missing origin phase or frequency masks future phase
control_forecast: complete ordered native piecewise-constant event tape, each segment carries command and duration; GRU16 event encoder per native state interval
test_policy: sealed; no test file opens, hashes, normalization, evaluation or selection
paired_cohort: identical registered 1s origins, also present in 500ms windows
